mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, user_name, target_department_id, target_department_name, reason, status, approver_id, approver_name, approve_comment, expire_time, apply_time, approve_time, create_time, update_time FROM data_scope_apply WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_scope_apply (user_id, user_name, target_department_id, target_department_name, reason, status, apply_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{targetDepartmentId}, #{targetDepartmentName}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE data_scope_apply SET status = #{status}, approver_id = #{approverId}, approver_name = #{approverName}, approve_comment = #{approveComment}, expire_time = #{expireTime}, approve_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, user_name, target_department_id, target_department_name, reason, status, approver_id, approver_name, approve_comment, expire_time, apply_time, approve_time, create_time, update_time FROM data_scope_apply WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_department_id = #{departmentId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time > NOW()) ORDER BY approve_time DESC
